cases.why: the first season is typed into the generator instead of read from config. It is right today and silently wrong the day TRAIN_SEASONS moves, which is the exact drift a line 'generated from config' exists to rule out.
the time is printed without UTC. A reader in New York reads 19:11 as their own evening, four hours off, and nothing on the page says otherwise.
the old footer is restored beside the new line -- the file-name week key and the '(s)' plural back on every page, with the provenance line still present so a check for it alone would pass.
the header's placeholder is filled with an empty string, which check_build cannot see (no placeholder is left), so the page says nowhere when it was built.
the <time> element loses its datetime, so the instant is only printed text and nothing reading the page can tell when it was built without parsing English.
